title: Core Discovery
scope: Read-only Records, Agents, Repositories, vocabulary, autocomplete. The minimum "I can be queried" claim.
card: The minimum "I can be queried" claim. Ten read-only endpoints, three entity types, no graph traversal. Every OpenRiC server starts here.

title: Authority & Context
scope: Places, Rules, Activities as first-class entities with reconciliation-friendly identifiers.
card: Reconciliation-friendly identifiers for places, rules, and activities. The profile that turns a catalogue into a knowledge graph.

title: Graph Traversal
scope: `/graph`, `/relations`, `/hierarchy` - cross-entity walks plus full-graph SHACL hygiene shapes.
card: Cross-entity walks keyed to a root URI + depth. Plus full-graph SHACL shapes for hygiene: orphaned records, unlinked agents, duplicate identifiers, typed-link mismatches.

title: Digital Object Linkage
scope: Instantiation carriers (MIME, checksums, extent, record-backlinks) plus ISDF Functions. Optional `POST /upload` + thumbnail derivative.
card: Concrete carriers of records - digital files, physical copies, checksums, MIME types - plus ISDF Functions. Optional POST /upload + thumbnail derivative for working catalogues.

title: Round-Trip Editing
scope: Full write surface - POST/PATCH/DELETE on every entity + relations, gated by API-key scopes, with a public audit trail via `/{type}/{id}/revisions`.
card: Write surface gated by API-key scopes (write, delete) with a public audit trail via /{type}/{id}/revisions. A client that mutated an entity can verify its own change landed.

title: Provenance & Event
scope: Tightened Activity shapes - Production/Accumulation/Activity with required results, participants, dates. Depends on Authority & Context.
card: Tightened Activity shapes: Production MUST carry results + participants + dates. Who did what to which record, when. Depends on Authority & Context.

title: Export-Only
scope: OAI-PMH v2.0 harvest (`oai_dc` + `rico_ld`) plus content-negotiated per-record JSON-LD / Turtle / RDF-XML dumps.
card: OAI-PMH v2.0 harvest (with the rico_ld prefix carrying full RiC-O JSON-LD) plus content-negotiated per-record dumps. Built for aggregators that already speak OAI-PMH.

title: SPARQL Access
scope: Read-only SPARQL 1.1 query endpoint (`/sparql`, `/sparql/info`), public-read, rate-limited, Update rejected.

title: Governance
surface: Pinned standards · IRI policy · change process
scope: The meaning layer - pinned standards, two-layer IRI policy, deprecate-not-delete stable IRIs, SHACL as a merge gate, versioned change process.

title: Portability
scope: Anti-lock-in - lossless JSON-LD/Turtle round-trip (proven by test), DCAT/VoID dataset descriptor + `/changelog`, optional validate-on-export.

title: Inferred-Provenance
scope: AI inference is never passed off as fact - `prov:wasGeneratedBy` + `assertionStatus`/confidence/receipt on machine assertions; absence ⇒ asserted fact.

title: Graph-Grounding
scope: Read-only `GET /ground` so any agent/RAG disambiguates against the graph; vector↔graph join on the public entity IRI; fail-open.
